column1: # Italian (it) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Italian video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Product, format and feature names (FilmCraft,
# ArtCraft, Lumetri, Essential Graphics, Essential Sound, AAF, EDL, FCPXML, OMF, OpenTimelineIO,
# timecode, proxy, clip, timeline…) keep their spelling. This catalog covers every menu; anything
# Terms: track = traccia, bin = contenitore, marker = segnaposto, playhead = testina di riproduzione,
# In/Out = In/Out (the points keep the English names used by Italian editors), transition =
# transizione, frame hold = fermo immagine, panel = pannello, workspace = area di lavoro, sequence =
# sequenza, clip = clip, render = rendering, export = esportazione, caption = sottotitolo, guide =
# guida, snap = aggancio, ripple = scorrimento, metadata = metadati. Voice: menus use the imperative
# ("Apri progetto…", "Aggiungi tracce…"). A trailing "…" is kept from the English source.
# Native review: not recorded. Entries were produced from the English meaning, not from any existing
